title: oncall: add SLO runbook quicklinks and auto-diagnostics helpers
author: Samira Khan
release_notes: Adds quicklinks to SLO runbooks in on-call messages and enhances auto-diagnostics context. No breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: On-call engineers need faster access to relevant SLO runbooks and context when incidents are detected. This PR adds quicklinks to SLO runbooks directly in incident-bot on-call notifications and enriches auto-diagnostics with selectable runbook suggestions and filtering to reduce noise.

Summary of changes: adds a runbook-linking helper that resolves SLO -> canonical runbook URLs, surfaces top-3 candidate runbooks in the autodiagnostics payload, introduces a per-SLO confidence filter and a global quiet-window to avoid duplicate suggestions. Includes unit tests, integration tests for the notification flow, and a migration to backfill runbook metadata.

Implementation details: the runbook resolver lives in services/runbook_resolver.py and is backed by a small cached index that maps slo_id -> [runbook_url, aliases, last_verified]. The incident-bot autodiag pipeline (workers/autodiag.py) now includes a step that queries the resolver and attaches up to three quicklinks to the on-call message payload under attachments.runbooks. A new env VAR INCIDENT_BOT_RUNBOOK_SENSITIVITY controls the confidence threshold; default is 0.6 to match current signal heuristics. We also added a 10-minute dedupe window keyed by incident fingerprint to avoid repetitive runbook suggestions during flaps.

Backward compatibility and rollout: feature is behind the feature flag "runbook_quicklinks" (off by default). Backfill script (tools/backfill_runbook_index.py) runs as an admin job and is safe to abort/retry. No changes to public HTTP APIs.

Testing and CI: added unit tests for resolver matching, integration test for outgoing Slack payloads, and e2e smoke test that validates a runbook quicklink appears in a synthetic incident. CI flaky e2e was addressed by increasing the test timeout and adding a deterministic seed.

Checklist:
- [x] add resolver and index store
- [x] attach quicklinks to autodiag payloads
- [x] unit and integration tests
- [x] feature flag + config via ENV
- [x] backfill tooling and migration notes

Rollout plan: merge to main -> enable feature flag for internal alpha -> enable for SRE on-call -> gradual enable org-wide over 48h with monitoring for false positives and alert noise.

Related: ENG-4921, ENG-5033, SUP-2391.
